Combat and equipment

Unsteady aim? Adjust sensitivity by sight type

The Sensitivity tab has separate settings for general view, iron and handmade sights, holosights and optical scopes. If only one sight feels wrong, change that setting without disturbing the others.

Choose gyroscope Off, While ADS or Always, with separate sight sensitivities. Acceleration, camera smoothing and axis inversion are also available. Make small changes and test your aim; recheck values if an update changes the feel.
